# ROS 2 Detection3DArray codec fixture

`jazzy.cdr` was generated by the **official rclpy serializer** with
`ros-jazzy-vision-msgs` 4.1.1-3noble.20260911.140407 in a disposable Jazzy container.
Package, serializer and SHA-256 are in `provenance.json`. The fields are synthetic;
this is not a detector recording.

The fixture contains Unicode and empty IDs, two classification hypotheses with
distinct poses/covariances, an empty results array, nontrivial box orientation and
sizes. Core tests decode these independent bytes rather than relying only on the
repository's encoder roundtrip. All truncations of this payload are also tested.

`schema.msg` records the ROS field layouts and dependencies used by MCAP fixtures.
Sources: [Detection3DArray](https://github.com/ros-perception/vision_msgs/blob/ros2/vision_msgs/msg/Detection3DArray.msg),
[Detection3D](https://github.com/ros-perception/vision_msgs/blob/ros2/vision_msgs/msg/Detection3D.msg),
[ObjectHypothesisWithPose](https://github.com/ros-perception/vision_msgs/blob/ros2/vision_msgs/msg/ObjectHypothesisWithPose.msg),
[BoundingBox3D](https://github.com/ros-perception/vision_msgs/blob/ros2/vision_msgs/msg/BoundingBox3D.msg).

The optional regeneration script is `tools/ros-fixture/generate_detection3d_cdr.py`
and requires ROS Jazzy + vision_msgs. It refuses to overwrite `jazzy.cdr`.
Normal playback and tests using the committed fixture require **no ROS installation**.
